$$
A\text{ is invertible}\,⇔\,\{\,\begin{aligned} & \bbox[3pt,white,border: 2px solid Gainsboro]{\phantom{WW}}={R}^{n} \\  & \text{dim(Col}(A))=n=\text{rank}(A) \\  & \text{Null}(A)=\{0\} \\  & \text{dim(Null}(A))=0=\text{nullity}(A)\end{aligned}
$$

Consider the equivalence above, where $A$ is an $n\,\times \,n$ matrix. Which of the following should be placed into the blank space to make a true statement?
